sections.title: Preservation, definability, and applications to topological structures

missing_pieces.duty: MP-0 partial: no topological definability theorem with its actual logical and topological assumptions is authored. This means no characterization of which L_2 formulas or properties are L_t-definable, no interpolation- or Beth-type definability for the topological logic, and no L_t non-definability result. Preservation theorems (basis, homeomorphism, reduced-ideal-product, ultraproduct) and applications are present. The packet is assessment-only (no owned or editable files), so closing this needs edits to the read-only hosts handbook/parts/p03/topological-model-theory.tex and handbook/annex/p03/topological-model-theory.tex.
